title: RunManifest
description: Run manifest, Evidence Contract v0.1 (schema_version 2.0.0). Hand-authored contract artifact; NOT generated by `sieve schemas export`. v1 (schemas/RunManifest.schema.json, schema_version 0.1.0) is retained unchanged and is DEPRECATED for new runs: it is kept only so that already-sealed v1 bundles keep validating. New runs MUST emit v2. Normative prose: docs/contract/evidence_contract_v0.1.md.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this manifest. Bumped on any change to the required set or to a hash domain.

run_id.description: Volatile per-run identifier. Excluded from the scientific seal.

created_at.description: Volatile. RFC 3339, UTC, second precision or finer. Excluded from the scientific seal.

command.description: Volatile (machine-local). Full argv as invoked, including every override flag. Excluded from the scientific seal but REQUIRED to be present: BACKLOG 'Evidence Contract v0.1' item 3 (CLI override paths must be recoverable).

code_provenance.description: Q1: OPTIONAL at the schema layer. Absence is a WARN surfaced by the reader, never a schema error. FAIL enforcement, where a profile requires it, is done by the conformance profile layer (docs/contract/evidence_contract_v0.1.md §6), not here.

seed_convention_version.description: B8. Version of the seed-derivation convention (master SeedSequence -> named children, spawn order). Included in the behavior_config_hash domain: changing the convention changes behaviour even at a fixed master_seed, so it must move the hash.

rng_algorithm.description: Q2: first-class typed top-level field, NOT an environment map key. Generator family actually used (e.g. 'numpy.PCG64', 'splitmix64').

rng_version.description: Q2: first-class typed top-level field. Version of that generator's stream definition, so a stream change is visible without diffing implementations.

runtime_fingerprint_domain_version.description: Q2: integer version of the SET OF KEYS hashed into environment_fingerprint_digest. The key list is registered in docs/contract/effective_config.md (registry section). Adding a key to `environment` does NOT change the digest; changing the registered domain REQUIRES bumping this integer, which makes the change visible in every downstream digest.

input_artifact_digests.description: Every declared input, content-addressed. BACKLOG 'Evidence Contract v0.1' item 1: calibration constants are inputs with a source reference and a digest, not code defaults.

conformance_map.description: The compatibility-resolution map ('ryoritsu-kai map'): per required contract item, how this run satisfied it and against which field. This is the machine-readable half of the (2.1 item -> field) resolution table; the schema stays permissive (Q1) while the profile decides severity. INTERPRETATION FLAG: the phrase in the W1D6 brief is read as 'the map that makes the schema-optional / profile-enforced split inspectable per run'. Confirm at the 2026-08-22 review.

item_ref.description: Stable id of the required item, e.g. '2.1-03'.

field_pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into this manifest (or into a referenced artifact) carrying the value.

status.description: Classification only. SATISFIED: present and verified. WARN: absent or unverified where the profile tolerates it. FAIL: absent where the profile requires it. UNVERIFIABLE: declared but its digest could not be obtained at audit time (B5, audit-time classification).

canary_results.description: References to canary evaluations attached to this run. REFERENCE + DIGEST ONLY: no CanaryResult payload may be duplicated here (enforced structurally by additionalProperties:false and by the absence of any payload-shaped property). Placement rationale in docs/contract/evidence_contract_v0.1.md §5.

outputs.description: Content-addressed outputs of this run, in the canonical forms defined by docs/contract/canonicalization.md.

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex sha256. sha256 is fixed by the contract; there is no algorithm-agility field anywhere in v2.

EnvironmentFingerprint.description: Q2, reserved-key scheme. A free string->string map whose RESERVED keys are named below for typing and documentation. Only the keys registered in docs/contract/effective_config.md (registry section) enter environment_fingerprint_digest; unregistered keys are recorded but not hashed. dependency_lock_digest is a RESERVED KEY here, not a top-level field.

dependency_lock_digest.description: sha256 of the canonicalized dependency lock file. Reserved key, hashed.

source_reference.description: Where the artifact came from, outside this repository's code. REQUIRED when artifact_type == 'calibration' (see the if/then below).

evidence_basis.description: How the value's provenance is established. 'external_measurement_not_rerunnable' is the case that motivated this field (BACKLOG, phi/sigma).

role.description: Free-text role of this input in the run.

verification.description: B5, AUDIT-TIME CLASSIFICATION. Separate clause from the run-time measure (fail-fast). 'unverifiable' means: the input was declared, but no digest could be obtained for it at consumption time.

EffectiveConfigRef.description: The resolved configuration actually in force, after defaults, files and CLI overrides. BACKLOG 'Evidence Contract v0.1' item 3.

effective_config_digest.description: sha256 of the canonicalized full effective config (docs/contract/canonicalization.md 3.1).

behavior_config_hash.description: sha256 over the behaviour-determining subset only (config keys + seed_convention_version + rng_algorithm + rng_version). Two runs with equal behavior_config_hash are expected to be behaviourally identical; this is the precondition of a same-engine semantic canary.

behavior_config_domain_version.description: Version of the key set entering behavior_config_hash. Registered in docs/contract/effective_config.md.

environment_fingerprint_digest.description: sha256 over the REGISTERED environment keys only, at runtime_fingerprint_domain_version.

registry_ref.description: Pointer to the registry document and its version that defines the two hash domains and the formula registry.

formula_bindings.description: Which formula id@version was in force for each formula slot, and the effective values it resolved to. Mirrors the formula registry section of effective_config.md.

result_digest.description: sha256 of the canonicalized CanaryResult document.

result_ref.description: Path or URI of the CanaryResult document, relative to the run directory when relative.

verdict.description: Copy of the referenced result's verdict, for reading without dereferencing. Classification only.

canonical_form.description: Which canonicalization rule produced the bytes that were hashed (docs/contract/canonicalization.md).
